lines.2: 「Hey, what are you doing out this late?」
lines.4: 「I couldn't sleep, so I went for a walk.」
lines.6: 「Huh? But there are plenty of people around. Lots of them seem perfectly comfortable walking here.」
lines.7: 「You don't realize it, but you stand out.」
lines.9: 「You're naive and defenseless... I worry about you.」
lines.10: 「Go home. You live nearby, right? Want me to walk you back?」
lines.11: 「I'll be fine. It isn't as though anyone is targeting me.」
lines.16: 「Then I'll do as you say and go home to bed. Good night.」
